name: msfs-2024-sdk
description: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 SDK reference, and live control of the sim through SimConnect.
long_description: Gives Claude access to the MSFS 2024 SDK installed on this PC (SimConnect.h, WASM headers, the catalogue of ~2000 key events, ModelBehaviorDefs with real SimVar / LVar examples, glTF schemas) and, while MSFS 2024 runs, the ability to read and write SimVars and LVars, send events and operate the cockpit input events.
